push.intro: Ful kɔstɔmayz fɔ ɛni webhook : JSON , Fɔm (x-www-form-urlencoded), ɔ yu yon Kastɔm ​​bɔdi tɛmplat wit <fieldkey></fieldkey> pleshɔlda dɛn (ɛgz. <example></example> ) - de wok lɛk fɔ ful-ɔp wan cURL kɔmand wan tɛm.

api.title: Yu API - Tu-We Akses fɔ Ɛni Sistɛm
